The chat history sheet (s18) opens when a user returns to a character from My Chats (s03), and Hidden Gems (s01.e15) marks characters from smaller creators made in the last 30 days. This change adds two things. First, a check when the sheet opens: is this character currently listed in Hidden Gems? No such check was seen on the sheet in the explored screens, so it is part of the change. Second, a new cheer count on the creator's public profile (s07); no cheer count was seen there. A card above Start new chat (s18.e14) offers a short window of faster replies with that character, and each verified play adds one cheer to its creator. The reward adds no extra replies. How much faster paid routing is, and what capacity it uses, were not measured in the explored screens.
